title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google Identity Sync from Google Workspace to Entra ID
summary: Hold: group sync does not create a new Microsoft 365 group for every Google group; Microsoft documents mapped-domain filtering and leaves matching existing groups unchanged. The cited pages also do not state that the tool has no fee, although they publish no tool-specific price. The roadmap facts and most documented sync behaviour are supported.

claims.claim: Google Identity Sync provides one-way user and group identity synchronization from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Google Identity Sync provides one-way synchronization of user and group identities from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: The tool is run from the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center, and then go to Setup > Migration resources.

claims.claim: Connecting requires signing in to Google Workspace as an administrator and installing the required migration app.
claims.quote: Follow the guided setup to sign in to Google Workspace as an administrator, install the required migration app in Google Workspace, and then complete the authentication flow by signing in again.

claims.claim: The tool discovers Google Workspace users and groups after the connection is established.
claims.quote: After the connection is established, Google Identity Sync automatically scans Google Workspace and displays the total number of discovered users and groups in the Discover card.

claims.quote: Domain mapping allows you to map Google Workspace domains to Microsoft 365 domains.

claims.claim: Only Google Workspace users in mapped domains are synchronized.
claims.quote: Only Google Workspace users whose email addresses belong to the mapped domains are synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Each synchronized Google user maps to an Entra user with the same email alias in the mapped domain.
claims.quote: Each Google Workspace user is synced to an Entra user with the same email alias in the mapped domain.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Active Google users are created as enabled Entra users.
claims.quote: Active Google Workspace users are created as enabled users in Entra ID.

claims.claim: Suspended Google users are created as disabled Entra users.
claims.quote: Suspended Google Workspace users are created as disabled users in Entra ID.

claims.claim: Archived Google users are excluded from synchronization.
claims.quote: Archived Google Workspace users are not included in the synchronization process.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: An existing Entra user with the same email alias is not overwritten or replaced with a new user.
claims.quote: If an Entra user with the same email alias already exists before synchronization, no new Entra user is created and the existing user isn't overwritten.

claims.claim: Sync groups creates a Microsoft 365 group for each Google group.
claims.quote: If a corresponding Microsoft 365 group doesn't exist, a new Microsoft 365 group is created. If a matching Microsoft 365 group already exists, no changes are made. Only Google Workspace groups whose email addresses belong to the mapped domains are synchronized.
claims.fix: Replace 'Sync groups then creates a Microsoft 365 group for each Google group and syncs its members and owners' with 'Sync groups then synchronises Google groups in mapped domains, creating a Microsoft 365 group where no corresponding group exists. Matching existing group objects are left unchanged, while member and owner assignments are synchronised.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepointmigration/google-identity-sync.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: What is synchronised
claims.claim: Group synchronization includes Google group members and owners.
claims.quote: The group synchronization process also synchronizes members of Google Workspace groups. ... If a destination owner or member doesn't exist in the Microsoft 365 group, the user is added with the appropriate role (Owner or Member).

claims.claim: The roadmap describes onboarding and one-way synchronization for Google customers moving to Microsoft 365, including creating identities and moving Drive and Mail content to OneDrive and Exchange Online.
claims.quote: This will be available as part of the M365 Admin center for Google compete customers moving into M365 to create the identities in M365 farm and move Drive and Mail content into Onedrive and Exchange online

claims.quote: Searched: preview and in development in the fully fetched https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepointmigration/google-identity-sync. The page describes the flow and tenant size restriction but contains no preview qualification.

claims.claim: The Learn Identity Sync page does not describe a synchronization schedule.
claims.quote: Searched: Google Identity Sync scheduled synchronization disable access setting audit events. Read google-identity-sync in full; it describes explicit Sync and Re-sync selections, not a schedule. Graph synchronization-overview describes a different provisioning mechanism.

claims.claim: Group re-sync applies supported Google group and membership updates, including matching member roles.
claims.quote: Supported attribute changes for a previously synchronized Google Workspace group are applied to the corresponding Microsoft 365 group. ... If the destination owner or member exists with a different role, the role is updated to match the source group.

claims.claim: Deleting a previously synchronized Google user does not modify the corresponding Entra user.
claims.quote: If a previously synced Google Workspace user is deleted, the corresponding Entra ID user isn't modified.

claims.claim: Deleting a synchronized Google group does not modify the corresponding Microsoft 365 group.
claims.quote: If a synchronized Google Workspace group is deleted in Google Workspace, the corresponding Microsoft 365 group isn't modified.
